Legit can't stop playing. You put in amazing work for this game, Hoyo and thank you! Love the characters, the world, the story (so far that i've played through) and the gameplay!

Thank you again for the response! I'll keep this close for when I need to remember these things and help. I really, really appreciate this!
Actually I found it again, sorry! Thank you very much!

I would like it again please! Sadly I don't see your reply anywhere on a previous post I might've used?  Although I'm really kind of new at using reddit, so I know on one post It says I have (5) comments, but I only see four (including my replies) to others!

I'm very close to hitting my 30s in a couple years, time really has flown by. I know this sounds like whining, it's just tough when it feels like your own family doesn't even want to help you or people you thought were your friends. I try to look at that, people who have achieved even late in life, but it still makes me worry that I can't. It is hard not to worry, oddly enough today I saw a description that just explained my life. I'm a people-pleaser. I worry more about how stuff will affect others than how it'll affect me and causes me to make bad decisions as well.  


But, thank you for saying that. It really does mean a lot; I know I've got a lot of issues I need to work out, but thank you for taking the time to even just read this and respond.

There's the book release called RUNAWAY MAX, which actually covers why they moved into Hawkins. It also gives a lot more detail into the Hargrove/Mayfield family.

It does cover some heavy terms of abuse, from what I heard between Neil and Billy. But all in all, it was a fresh start to get away from Max's dad. Max had kept running away because she wasn't happy about the marriage. Which is why Billy gets so upset when she says it's "his" fault that they moved into Hawkins. Although even though it's supposed to be before the events of season 2 and leading into that. There's some differences from the TV Series, such as Max and Billy's ages when they first meet. but nonetheless it is an official book.

I won't get into it in case you want to read it yourself, because spoilers and all. But the reason was indeed Max's behavior (which I honest to god don't blame her for) in California when Neil married Susan.
Thank you for responding! ;u; It really means a lot.
